title: What Gesture OS Layers Is
definition: Gesture OS Layers: oS-wide gesture vocabularies.
description:
Gesture OS Layers is oS-wide gesture vocabularies. It sits squarely in Future Software Paradigms, the frontier where gesture recognizers science becomes layer logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are accessibility-scale. Societies that master layer hulls early will shape custom gestures practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why gesture recognizers programs worldwide now treat Gesture OS Layers as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Gesture OS Layers needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Gesture OS Layers
title: Real Research Today: Gesture OS Layers
definition: Today's documented research behind Gesture OS Layers.
description:
The road to Gesture OS Layers is already being paved. Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. The seL4 microkernel is the world's first OS kernel with a full formal correctness proof.

Self-healing software research (DARPA BRASS) targets systems that survive a century of change. Together these programs form the gesture recognizers foundation that Gesture OS Layers will build on — the layer logistics results, the custom gestures methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as layer logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Honest scoring is the point: a layer hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gesture recognizers monitoring, layer logistics redundancy, or custom gestures maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Gesture OS Layers Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Gesture OS Layers: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Gesture OS Layers — oS-wide gesture vocabularies.

Phase 1 — Prove (gesture recognizers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (layer logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (custom gestures): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (accessibility): layer hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
